about.desc: Full Stack developer with 5+ years of professional experience building software. I work with startups and companies that need someone to solve complex technical problems — from backend to deployment, no middlemen.

exp.title: Experience.
exp.r1Context: Software factory for the pharmaceutical industry
exp.r1Core: Responsible for the evolution, maintenance, and development of enterprise applications used by companies in the pharmaceutical industry. I build new features, optimize existing processes, and solve specific requirements on production systems where stability and operational continuity are critical. I take part in technical decisions, architecture improvements, and solutions geared toward scalability, maintainability, and software quality.
exp.r2Core: I led a development team, combining technical leadership with hands-on development. I coordinated planning and delivery, took part in defining architecture and scalable solutions, and established development best practices and code review. I was the technical reference and point of contact for international development teams, turning business needs into concrete solutions while actively building and evolving the platforms.
exp.r3Title: Team Lead · Senior Full Stack Developer
exp.r3Core: I led a development team, combining technical leadership with hands-on development. I coordinated planning and delivery, took part in defining architecture and scalable solutions, and established development best practices and code review. I was the technical reference and point of contact for international development teams, turning business needs into concrete solutions while actively building and evolving the platforms.
exp.r4Core: End-to-end development and maintenance of an e-commerce platform — backend, frontend, and infrastructure. I implemented features, optimized existing processes, and worked on integrating and deploying applications on AWS.
exp.r5Core: Level 2 support on systems critical to logistics and shipping operations: incident analysis and resolution, monitoring of production processes, and automation of operational tasks with Bash and Rundeck, on Linux and Windows environments.

srv.title: What I can do for your team.
srv.lede: I work both on fixed-scope projects and longer contracts. What matters is that the problem gets solved and the code stays maintainable.
srv.s1Desc: End-to-end web applications — frontend, backend, deploy. React, TypeScript, .NET, Laravel. From zero to production.
srv.s2Desc: Connecting systems — CRMs, payment gateways, ERPs, external services. Clean, documented, and testable design.
srv.s2d1: Design and implementation of REST APIs
srv.s3Desc: Team lead for 3 to 8 people. Code reviews, planning, standards, 1:1 mentoring.
srv.s4Desc: Migrating old stacks to modern ones. Incremental refactor, tests, zero-downtime deploys. PHP, .NET Framework, jQuery to TypeScript.

proc.title: A simple process, no surprises.
proc.lede: Four steps. The same ones I apply on every project.
proc.p1Desc: I unpack the business problem, map technical constraints, and define measurable success.
proc.p2Desc: Concrete proposal: scope, stack, deliverables, timeline. No ambiguity.
proc.p3Desc: Short deliveries, weekly demos, code in repos from day one.
proc.p4Desc: Brief documentation, reproducible deploy, post-delivery support window.
